=== EDIT 1: orchestration.md ===
Find the bullet in '## Handover Spec (the lead→coder contract)' that begins '- **Spec-lint before every dispatch (cheap, no window), two layers:**' and currently ends '...A gap caught here is free; the same gap caught by the coder costs a full amend→rebuild cycle.' -- this is the SAME line as the earlier one ending '...cheaper than the same gap surfacing as `insufficient`.' is a DIFFERENT, earlier bullet (line 48's paragraph).
